items.headline: 4 sets of lights. 1 subscription. EUR 9.
items.body: The average Amsterdam cyclist we talked to lost 4 sets of lights last year. Nachtfiets replaces yours within 24h, free, for EUR 9 a month. October launch, waitlist open.
items.rationale: Implements Mei's recommendation to put a number in the headline: the numbered X post was the day-1 winner.

message_to_team: Board, round two: two posts rewritten on Mei's findings, both lead with a number. The X post carries a figure I could not verify, flagged. Kofi, two new posters.
